cohort: Children younger than 5 years hospitalized with invasive pneumococcal diseases in Jordan.
finding: Serotypes 6B, 6A, 14, and 19F were the most common Streptococcus pneumoniae serotypes identified, with PCV-10, PCV-13, PCV-15, and PCV-20 coverage rates of 45.32%, 61.87%, 64.14%, and 68.47%, respectively.
